精心组织的 ComfyUI 工作流程，专为专业动漫风格角色生成而设计，具有军事级质量控制。该工作流程将 waiIllustriousSDXL_v160 基本模型的强大功能与先进的接口设计原理相结合，以实现最高的效率和质量。

### ✨ 主要特点：

🔹 干净、有组织的界面：

- 专业的标签系统带有颜色编码的节标题（← PROMPT、← NEGATIVE PROMPT、← UPSCALE、← NOTE）

- 快速组旁路节点允许一键启用/禁用整个工作流程部分

- 所有复杂节点都整齐地分组和隐藏，以实现最大的工作空间清晰度

- 颜色协调的视觉层次结构，用于直观的导航

🔹先进的质量控制：

- 内置图像比较器节点用于实时前后质量评估

- 关键工作流程阶段的并排比较工具

- 视觉反馈系统评估升级和细节改进

- 整个生成管道的专业级质量检查点

🔹灵活的装载系统：

- 动力劳拉装载机 (rg Three)用于无缝 LoRA 管理的节点

- 为常见增强类型预配置多个 LoRA 插槽

- 每个 LoRA 组件的单独切换控制

- 轻松调整强度，无需中断工作流程

🔹 生产就绪的升级：

- 4x RealESRGAN 动漫升级 realesrganX4plusAnime_v1.pt) 内置

- 自动分辨率优化（832x1216 → 1472x2177）

- 每个关键阶段的集成保存点

- 专用的高档比较工具来验证质量增益

🔹 性能优化：

- RTX 4060 Ti 友好具有 VRAM 优化的配置

- 批量大小默认为 1，可在 8GB 卡上实现最大稳定性

- 高效的节点路由以最短的生成时间

- 切换系统以在测试运行期间禁用非必要功能

### ⚙️ 技术要求：

所需型号：

- 检查站: waiIllustriousSDXL_v160.safetensors

- 升级者: realesrganX4plusAnime_v1.pt

所需的 ComfyUI 扩展：

- rg三舒适（适用于 Power Lora Loader、Fast Groups Bypasser、标签节点和图像比较器）

- ComfyUI 冲击包（推荐用于高级细节设计功能）

- ComfyUI_UltimateSDUpscale（为了获得最佳的放大结果）

### 🚀 如何使用：

1.安装所有必需的扩展（rg Three-comfy 是必不可少的）

2.加载工作流程进入ComfyUI

3.自定义提示在专用的 CLIP 文本编码节点中

4.打开/关闭部分使用 Fast Groups Bypasser 节点：

- 一键启用/禁用升级

- 激活/停用特定 LoRA 包

- 根据您的需求控制工作流程的复杂性

5.比较结果使用内置图像比较器节点来评估质量改进

6.保存输出多个阶段（基础生成、详细、升级）

### 💡 专业提示：

为了获得最佳结果：

- 使用图像比较器最终保存之前验证升级质量的节点

- 进行快速测试生成时关闭非必要功能

- 利用有组织的标签系统快速导航复杂的工作流程

- 调整 Power Lora Loader 节点中的 LoRA 强度以实现自定义风格

性能优化：

- 对于 RTX 4060 Ti 等 8GB VRAM 卡：将批量大小保持为 1

- 进行即时测试时禁用升级

- 使用切换系统将 VRAM 集中在活动工作流程部分

- 保存中间结果以避免完全重新生成

定制指南：

- 添加您最喜欢的 LoRA到 Power Lora Loader 节点

- 修改提示在 CLIP 文本编码部分中针对不同样式

- 调整放大参数满足不同分辨率的需求

- 重新着色标签符合您的个人工作流程偏好

### 🎯 工作流程结构：

左侧 - 核心生成：

- 使用 EmptyLatentImage 生成基础 SDXL

- 带切换控制的 LoRA 管理系统

- 核心提示工程部分

中间部分 - 质量控制：

- 用于视觉验证的图像比较器节点

- 快速组旁路切换系统

- 在关键阶段保存积分

右侧 - 高级功能：

- 通过质量验证升级管道

- 不同输出阶段的专用保存节点

- 带有颜色编码标签的视觉组织系统

### 🏆 为什么这个工作流程脱颖而出：

✅ 专业组织- 不再有凌乱的节点意大利面条

✅ 一键切换- 立即启用/禁用功能

✅ 内置质量验证- 实时查看改进

✅ 显存优化- 非常适合 RTX 4060 Ti 和类似卡

✅ 生产就绪- 在每个关键阶段保存输出

✅ 适合初学者- 清晰的标签引导您完成每个部分

✅ 面向未来- 模块化设计方便扩展

非常适合对质量和工作流程效率都有要求的动漫艺术家、角色设计师和人工智能艺术专业人士。这不仅仅是一个工作流程——它是专为认真的创作者设计的完整制作流程。

o.en:
A meticulously organized ComfyUI workflow designed for professional anime-style character generation with military-grade quality control.This workflow combines the power of the waiIllustriousSDXL_v160 base model with advanced interface design principles for maximum efficiency and quality.

### ✨ KEY FEATURES:

🔹 CLEAN, ORGANIZED INTERFACE:

- Professional labeling systemwith color-coded section headers (← PROMPT, ← NEGATIVE PROMPT, ← UPSCALE, ← NOTE)

- Fast Groups Bypasser nodesallow one-click enable/disable of entire workflow sections

- All complex nodes are neatly grouped and hidden for maximum workspace clarity

- Color-coordinated visual hierarchy for intuitive navigation

🔹 ADVANCED QUALITY CONTROL:

- Built-in Image Comparer nodesfor real-time before/after quality assessment

- Side-by-side comparison tools at critical workflow stages

- Visual feedback system to evaluate upscaling and detailing improvements

- Professional-grade quality checkpoints throughout the generation pipeline

🔹 FLEXIBLE LOADING SYSTEM:

- Power Lora Loader (rgthree)nodes for seamless LoRA management

- Multiple LoRA slots pre-configured for common enhancement types

- Individual toggle controls for each LoRA component

- Easy strength adjustment without workflow disruption

🔹 PRODUCTION-READY UPSCALING:

- 4x RealESRGAN Anime Upscaling realesrganX4plusAnime_v1.pt) built-in

- Automatic resolution optimization (832x1216 → 1472x2177)

- Integrated save points at every critical stage

- Dedicated upscale comparison tools to verify quality gains

🔹 OPTIMIZED FOR PERFORMANCE:

- RTX 4060 Ti friendlyconfiguration with VRAM optimization

- Batch size 1 default for maximum stability on 8GB cards

- Efficient node routing for minimal generation time

- Toggle system to disable non-essential features during test runs

### ⚙️ TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Required Models:

- Checkpoint: waiIllustriousSDXL_v160.safetensors

- Upscaler: realesrganX4plusAnime_v1.pt

Required ComfyUI Extensions:

- rgthree-comfy(for Power Lora Loader, Fast Groups Bypasser, Label nodes, and Image Comparer)

- ComfyUI-Impact-Pack(recommended for advanced detailing capabilities)

- ComfyUI_UltimateSDUpscale(for optimal upscaling results)

### 🚀 HOW TO USE:

1.Install all required extensions(rgthree-comfy is essential)

2.Load the workflowinto ComfyUI

3.Customize promptsin the dedicated CLIP text encode nodes

4.Toggle sections on/offusing the Fast Groups Bypasser nodes:

- Enable/disable upscaling with one click

- Activate/deactivate specific LoRA packs

- Control workflow complexity based on your needs

5.Compare resultsusing the built-in Image Comparer nodes to evaluate quality improvements

6.Save outputsat multiple stages (base generation, detailed, upscaled)

### 💡 PRO TIPS:

For Best Results:

- Use theImage Comparernodes to verify upscaling quality before final save

- Toggle off non-essential features when doing quick test generations

- Leverage theorganized labeling systemto quickly navigate complex workflows

- Adjust LoRA strengths in the Power Lora Loader nodes for custom stylization

Performance Optimization:

- For 8GB VRAM cards like RTX 4060 Ti: keep batch size at 1

- Disable upscaling when doing prompt testing

- Use the toggle system to focus VRAM on active workflow sections

- Save intermediate results to avoid full re-generation

Customization Guide:

- Add your favorite LoRAsto the Power Lora Loader nodes

- Modify promptsin the CLIP text encode sections for different styles

- Adjust upscaling parametersfor different resolution needs

- Recolor labelsto match your personal workflow preferences

### 🎯 WORKFLOW STRUCTURE:

Left Side - Core Generation:

- Base SDXL generation with EmptyLatentImage

- LoRA management system with toggle controls

- Core prompt engineering section

Middle Section - Quality Control:

- Image Comparer nodes for visual verification

- Fast Groups Bypasser toggle system

- Save points at critical stages

Right Side - Advanced Features:

- Upscaling pipeline with quality verification

- Dedicated save nodes for different output stages

- Visual organization system with color-coded labels

### 🏆 WHY THIS WORKFLOW STANDS OUT:

✅ Professional organization- no more messy node spaghetti

✅ One-click toggles- enable/disable features instantly

✅ Built-in quality verification- see improvements in real-time

✅ VRAM optimized- perfect for RTX 4060 Ti and similar cards

✅ Production ready- save outputs at every critical stage

✅ Beginner friendly- clear labels guide you through each section

✅ Future proof- modular design allows easy expansion

Perfect for anime artists, character designers, and AI art professionals who demand both quality and workflow efficiency.This isn't just a workflow - it's a complete production pipeline designed for serious creators.
